description: web-ifc is a JavaScript library for reading and writing Industry Foundation Classes building models. That Open Company provides the engine, documentation, browser examples and an npm package. Users provide an IFC file or byte array; the library returns geometry, properties and model entities for a web-based BIM workflow. Geographic coverage follows the building or facility in the input IFC file. GitHub metadata identifies MPL-2.0 licensing for the repository. A limitation is that parsing IFC does not verify the engineering correctness of source geometry or turn the file into an energy or structural simulation. Application developers need to check schema versions, units and lost properties when converting models. web-ifc can prepare or inspect building representations for digital twins and infrastructure simulation. The related catalogue IfcOpenShell platform is a separate C++ and Python IFC engine. No IFC file, npm package or built viewer was downloaded.
